courses.title: Basic Computer Course
courses.description: Comprehensive grounding in computing fundamentals. Learn operating system structures, basic typing, internet protocols, safe browsing, email navigation, and general computer hardware awareness.

courses.title: MS Office Suite
courses.description: Master professional office software. Detailed modules covering MS Word (document processing), MS Excel (spreadsheets and basic analysis), MS PowerPoint (presentations), and Outlook.

courses.title: Python Programming
courses.description: Kickstart your programming career. Learn variables, data structures, conditional logic, loops, object-oriented concepts, exception handling, data storage, and complete functional projects.

courses.title: Java Technology
courses.description: Master robust systems programming. Coverage includes Core Java foundations, Object-Oriented Principles, Multi-threading, Exception handling, collection frameworks, and JDBC database connections.

courses.title: C | C++ Programming
courses.description: The fundamentals of computing. Master manual memory allocation, pointer arithmetic, procedural structures in C, and shift to Object Oriented systems, classes, templates, and inheritance in C++.

courses.title: SQL Database
courses.description: Learn structured databases. Covers tables, primary/foreign keys, SELECT queries, filters, group functions, complex JOINS, subqueries, view creation, and execution plan optimization.

courses.title: Advanced Excel
courses.description: Elevate your analytical skills. Focuses on complex nested formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, index-match combos, dynamic pivot tables, slicers, what-if tools, basics of macros, and rich dynamic dashboards.

courses.title: Tally with GST
courses.description: Professional accounting course. Learn double-entry bookkeeping, voucher entry (sales, purchase, payment), bank reconciliation statements, inventory sheets, CGST/SGST ledger, and returns generation.

courses.title: AutoCAD (2D & 3D)
courses.description: Computer-Aided Drafting (CAD) system. Drafting structural engineering layouts, civil architecture blueprints, mechanical 3D parts, views, dimensioning, layers, blocks, and rendering models.

courses.title: Graphic Design Studio
courses.description: Visual arts training. Acquire hands-on proficiency in Adobe Photoshop (image manipulation), Adobe Illustrator (vector artwork), and CorelDraw (print design and vector layouts).

courses.title: Computer Networking
courses.description: Network administration basics. Study OSI models, TCP/IP structures, dynamic routing, ethernet cabling setups, network security concepts, IP subnets, and local server configurations.

courses.title: Video Editing + FX
courses.description: Learn modern post-production. Master timeline editing, multi-cam cuts, audio correction, typography overlay, transitions, color grading with Lumetri, and keyframe animations.

courses.title: JBT / B.Ed / LLB / Degree
courses.description: Professional coaching and admission guidance for academic university programs. Streamlined classes, preparation strategy guides, and academic support for JBT, B.Ed, LLB, and Graduation paths.

courses.title: Classes 6th to 12th Coaching
courses.description: Specialized coaching classes for school students (Classes 6th to 12th) across all streams (Science, Commerce, and Humanities/Arts). Individual focus to secure excellent marks.
